description: This Java source file defines the MockServerRule class, which implements JUnit's TestRule to manage the lifecycle of a MockServer instance during tests. It includes constructors for different configurations, methods to retrieve server ports, and internal logic to start, stop, and reset the server, as well as inject the server client into test classes.
